description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for managing credit bureau configurations in the Apache Fineract project. It provides endpoints for retrieving, updating, and creating credit bureau related data, mappings, and configurations.

classes.name: CreditBureauConfigurationApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class providing endpoints for managing credit bureau configurations within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: getCreditBureau
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve all credit bureau data.

methods.name: getCreditBureauLoanProductMapping
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve credit bureau loan product mappings.

methods.name: getOrganisationCreditBureau
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve organization credit bureau data.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve configuration data for a specific organization credit bureau.

methods.name: fetchLoanProducts
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve loan product mappings.

methods.name: fetchMappingByLoanProductId
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve mapping details for a specific loan product ID.

methods.name: updateCreditBureau
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update organization credit bureau data.

methods.name: updateCreditBureauLoanProductMapping
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update credit bureau loan product mappings.

methods.name: addOrganisationCreditBureau
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a new organization credit bureau.

methods.name: createCreditBureauLoanProductMapping
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new credit bureau loan product mapping.

methods.name: createCreditBureauConfiguration
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new credit bureau configuration.

methods.name: updateCreditBureauConfiguration
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing credit bureau configuration.
